byteward.sentence: Sable Labs released Sable 4 on Wednesday, the newest version of its AI model.
It comes in three sizes, with 8 billion, 32 billion, and 120 billion parameters.
The company says Sable 4 scores 18% higher than Sable 3 on its in-house coding tests.
Developers can use Sable 4 through the company's API for $1.20 per million input tokens.
The 8 billion and 32 billion parameter versions are also free to download and run on your own computer.

launch-desk.sentence: Sable Labs has launched Sable 4, the latest version of its AI model.
Developers pay $1.20 per million input tokens to use it through the API.
The two smaller versions, with 8 billion and 32 billion parameters, cost nothing to download.

frametime.sentence: Sable Labs released Sable 4 today, its newest AI model.
Its 8-billion and 32-billion-parameter versions are free to download.
Squeezed to 4-bit precision, the 32-billion-parameter version needs about 20 GB of graphics memory.
On a 24 GB card, it generated 41 tokens per second in our testing.
The 8-billion-parameter version hit 118 tokens per second on a 12 GB card.

ohm-and-bit.sentence: Sable Labs unveiled Sable 4 on Wednesday, the latest version of its AI model.
It ships in three sizes: 8 billion, 32 billion, and 120 billion parameters.
The 120-billion-parameter version is a mixture-of-experts design, so it uses only 15 billion parameters for each token it writes.
Every version can read up to 200,000 tokens in a single prompt.
Compressed to 4-bit precision, the 32-billion-parameter version fits in roughly 20 GB of memory.
Sable Labs says that compression costs about 2% on its accuracy tests.

bench-and-bill.sentence: Sable Labs released Sable 4 on Wednesday, its newest AI model.
The company also sent a 48-page safety report to the National Cyber Readiness Office.
In that report, outside testers say Sable 4 refused 96% of requests to write malware.
Sable Labs committed to telling the office about serious misuse within 72 hours of finding it.
No rule required the filing, and Sable Labs made it voluntarily.
